name: gizza-ai/elo-rating-calculator
summary: Compute Elo expected scores, rating deltas and new ratings for a two-player match or same-opponent series.

tool.description: Elo rating calculator for a two-player match or a same-opponent series. Provide player_a_rating, player_b_rating, score_a (1 win, 0.5 draw, 0 loss, or total points across games), and optionally k_factor (default 32), games, player-specific k_factor_b, max_rating_difference such as 400 for FIDE-style caps, decimals and output_format. It returns both players' expected scores, signed rating changes, new ratings, formula substitution, win/draw/loss scenarios, and JSON/CSV/delta outputs. Pure arithmetic, no network.

decimals.description: Decimal places for rating changes and final ratings. Default 0 for whole rating points; use 1-6 to inspect unrounded values.

games.description: Number of games represented by score_a. Use 1 for a single match; for a same-opponent series, enter the count and score_a as total points. Default 1.

k_factor.description: K-factor for Player A. Common values: 10 master/low volatility, 20 standard/FIDE established, 32 online default, 40 new players. Default 32.

k_factor_b.description: Optional K-factor for Player B. Leave 0 to mirror k_factor; set a value when the players have different development factors.

max_rating_difference.description: Optional cap on the rating difference used in the expected-score formula. 0 disables the cap; 400 matches the common FIDE cap.

output_format.description: Output shape. summary gives both players, expected scores, formula substitutions and scenarios; scenarios prints win/draw/loss what-ifs; json and csv are machine-readable; delta returns Player A's signed rating change only.

player_a_name.description: Optional display name for Player A, up to 60 characters. Used in summaries, JSON and CSV.

player_a_rating.description: Player A's starting Elo rating, from 0 to 5000. Example: 1600.

player_b_name.description: Optional display name for Player B, up to 60 characters. Used in summaries, JSON and CSV.

player_b_rating.description: Player B's starting Elo rating, from 0 to 5000. Default 1500.

score_a.description: Player A's actual score: 1 for a win, 0.5 for a draw, 0 for a loss. For a series, enter total points across games; player B's score is games - score_a. Default 1.
